fundamental.summary: FE shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 67 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for FE; congressional activity is stale (6+ months), market sentiment is neutral, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (338.56) indicates extreme market stress, and utilities face credit spread pressure in high-rate environment; earnings in 67 days adds moderate event risk.
